primary_focus.reason: The phase centers purpose-bound identity authorization, credential-status privacy, wording-version non-substitution, affected-party authority, and exact preservation of Māori authority boundaries.

mind_preservation: GMUT is addressed through typed kinetic-Hessian, calibration-covariance, empirical zero-row, and evidence-class obligations without physical or empirical promotion.
body_preservation: THOS is addressed through participant-safety, withdrawal, stopping-rule, matched-budget, blinding, ethics-review, and real-arm gaps without superiority or personhood-adjacent claims.
heart_preservation: Freed ID remains structural or represented until real keys, proofs, live services, status, interoperability, privacy assurance, independent security review, and governance exist. CBR and Māori wording, authority, data governance, cultural ratification, and legal status remain exact-gated.
boundary: A primary focus allocates phase attention; it does not make one pillar evidence for another or confer authority.
